title: [task] characterization test for dateFromDaysSinceEpoch
body:
add a characterization test for dateFromDaysSinceEpoch in src/tenmin-range-entries.ts: utc day numbers
- dateFromDaysSinceEpoch(0) is "1970-01-01"
- dateFromDaysSinceEpoch(20454) is "2026-01-01"
- dateFromDaysSinceEpoch(-1) throws INVALID_RANGE
- dateFromDaysSinceEpoch(1.5) throws INVALID_RANGE
